description:
Nicole Valentine, Senior Director of Fintech at the Milken Institute, discusses her transition from entrepreneurship to shaping financial policy, and shares insights on her role at the think tank in this episode with Forbes senior writer Jabari Young at Nasdaq MarketSite. Valentine also explores the outlook for stablecoins, discusses the future of AI in fintech, and outlines what sets exceptional fintech startups apart from the rest.

description:
Meet Miha Jagovic, the visionary founder behind Bloq.it, a smart parcel locker company completely revolutionizing the last-mile logistics industry. In this interview, Miha breaks down how he took his startup from just four lockers on the ground to a massive B2B network seeing over 100 million uses a year.
